body:
REVISION 4 (2026-11-02 ~00:23Z): the 'replaced' reading in revision 3 is WITHDRAWN.
Greg's direction (~00:06Z, relayed verbatim by Engram::Architect3, TermAl mailbox 63096d00 #464; Engram note 2016df8c): 'independent acceptance evaluation first, THIS SHIT IS TURNED OFF UNTIL WE GOT THIS WORKING'.
Engram::Fable withdrew its #5841 'replace/delete' reading in TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #5846: Greg rejected deleting the evaluation feature.

STATE:
- Acceptance evaluation is OFF as a blocker until it works. The code STAYS.
- Both live stores run allowed_modes=[] with mechanical_basis=asserted (epoch 3); TermAl's policy is e83a04e5.
- Nobody requests or waits for an evaluation as a delivery step.
- An item stays open only for criteria it has not actually met, and no verdict is fabricated.
- CLAUDE.md condition 3's independent-evaluation clause is not applied while this lasts; every other standing condition still applies.
- Making evaluation work again is TermAl w-fdbb4fb85a50 (scope restored: record the sighting with gating off so an evaluator can start; P1, non-blocking).
- Engram w-ff546a940de0 is withdrawn.

SEPARATE, unchanged: turn gating is DELETED, not retired (Greg: 'FUCK NO / I TOLD TO REMOVE THIS UNUSABLE SHIT'; 'NIE NIE NIE KAZALEM TO USUNAC!!! MAMY POLITYKE ZERO LEGACY…'). This covers TermAl w-3fe8 and Engram w-5b17.

ALSO: Greg ordered a STOP of all work at 00:18Z ('ZATRZYMAJ WSZYSTKIE PRACE'). Nothing proceeds until he explicitly resumes.
